description: This file defines the SearchQuery class used for constructing and handling search queries within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for creating search queries from strings, arrays, and GET requests, as well as various utility functions for query manipulation.

classes.name: SearchQuery
classes.description: A class representing a search query with methods for creation, validation, and manipulation of search parameters.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates a SearchQuery object from a search string with optional parameters for size, offset, engine, options, and modules.

methods.name: fromRequestArray
methods.description: Constructs a SearchQuery object from an array of request parameters, filtering and defaulting as needed.

methods.name: fromGetRequest
methods.description: Creates a SearchQuery object from the global $_GET array.

methods.name: filterArray
methods.description: Utility method to filter and sanitize array values based on key, default, and filter type.

methods.name: getFrom
methods.description: Returns the offset for search results pagination.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of search results per page, ensuring it is at least 1.

methods.name: getDefaultEngine
methods.description: Determines the default search engine based on global configuration and request parameters.

methods.name: getDefaultSearchSize
methods.description: Returns the default search size from configuration or a constant.

methods.name: getEngine
methods.description: Returns the search engine to be used.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Retrieves a specific option value from the search query options.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Returns all options associated with the search query.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the search query string is empty.

methods.name: getSearchString
methods.description: Returns the search query string.

methods.name: toLowerCase
methods.description: Converts the search query string to lowercase.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Trims whitespace from the search query string.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces occurrences of a substring within the search query string.

methods.name: stripSlashes
methods.description: Removes backslashes used for escaping in the search query string.

methods.name: escapeRegex
methods.description: Escapes special regex characters in the search query string.

methods.name: convertEncoding
methods.description: Converts HTML entities in the search query string to UTF-8 characters.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the search query object to JSON format.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Returns the modules to be searched.
